svg.title: From certified mechanics to an unresolved coarse shape prediction
svg.desc: Two proved model statements feed into an open equilibrium and calibration problem. The proposed next certificate compares an energy upper bound with a lower bound for excluded coarse shapes. This is a logical roadmap, not measured data.

g.text: Certified: the old force balance changes
Both K/L small-patch fields admit relaxed descent.
This does not determine a new fold depth.
Proved: fine folds can fit a finite slab
Small position error; fixed surface-area change.
The constructed maps are not selected equilibria.
Open: what do admissible, recalibrated equilibria predict?
State the observer, wall conditions, physical scale range and selection rule.
Target: an energy exclusion certificate for coarse shape
Wrong-shape lower bound > trial upper bound + optimization error.
Solid boxes: established model results. Dashed boxes: research targets. No biological or novelty claim.
